blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Learning world models across diverse domains calls for a unified control space, yet ac- tion interfaces vary across domains and action annotations are often scarce. Latent ac- tions learned directly from videos offer a promising way to establish such a space without explicit action supervision. However, learning shared latent actions across domains re- mains challenging, as variations in appearance, embodiment, and dynamics can entangle domain-specific visual cues with transferable transition structure. To this end, we intro- duce OneLA, a simple framework that learns continuous latent actions through a shared orthogonal dictionary and a common predictive objective, without task-specific designs or cross-domain alignment losses during latent action pretraining. These latent actions pro- vide a shared conditioning interface for world models, with lightweight adapters mapping native control commands into the same space. Conditioned on latent actions and the cur- rent visual state, the world model predicts context-dependent transitions for controllable rollout. OneLA improves action readout across domains and reduces action cycle-transfer rotation error by 24.8% over the strongest evaluated baseline. A joint-training comparison further shows a 20.5% improvement in Human Preference Score v3 (HPSv3) for real- scene generation. These results suggest a path toward general-purpose world models that learn from diverse videos and support flexible control through latent action space.

OneLA改进了跨域的动作读取,并将动作周期转移旋转误差比最强的评价基线减少24.8%. 联合训练比较进一步显示,在真实场景生成方面,人类首选分数v3(HPSv3)提高20.5%. 这些结果显示了通向通用世界模式的道路,从各种视频中学习,并通过潜在行动空间支持灵活控制。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: World models enable agents to anticipate the consequences of their actions and learn behavior through simulated interaction [ 27 , 28 , 1 ] . Extending this capability across games, navigation, driving, and robotics calls for a shared action space that connects heterogeneous control interfaces to a common predictive model. Yet much of the available video data captures interactions without recording the underlying commands [ 23 , 60 ] . A shared space learned from visual transitions could make these unlabeled videos useful for controllable world modeling.
blocks.zh: 世界模型使代理商能够预见其行为的后果,并通过模拟互动学习行为[27,28,1]. 将这种能力扩展到游戏、导航、驾驶和机器人之间,需要共享行动空间,将各种控制界面与共同的预测模型相连接。 然而,许多可用的视频数据可以捕捉互动,而不记录基本指令[23,60]. 从视觉过渡中吸取的共享空间可以使这些无标签的视频对可控制的世界建模有用.

blocks.en: Recent studies infer latent actions from videos to learn controllable world models [ 6 , 23 ] . AdaWorld adapts world models to new control interfaces, while Garrido et al. [24] study action transfer across natural videos. Other work guides learning with agent localization [ 20 ] , task descriptions or action-category priors [ 43 , 18 ] , synchronized views [ 37 ] , or labeled robot actions [ 33 , 2 , 39 , 15 ] . These signals help identify relevant visual changes, but are not uniformly available across sources. We study how a common regularizer can structure continuous actions across heterogeneous videos for a shared world-model interface.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究推断出从视频中潜在的行动来学习可控制的世界模型[6,23]. AdaWorld将世界模型适应新的控制界面,而Garrido等. [24] 研究动作转移跨越自然视频. 其他工作指导与代理本地化[20],任务说明或动作类前作[43,18],同步视图[37],或被标注为机器人动作[33,2,39,15]. 这些信号有助于识别相关的视觉变化,但不同来源之间并不一致。 我们研究一个普通的常态化器 如何为共享的世界模型界面 构建跨不同视频的连续动作

blocks.en: Learning this shared interface presents two challenges. First, regularization must encourage reusable motion structure without discarding information needed to represent diverse transitions. Frame prediction alone can retain scene-specific or uncontrolled changes alongside motion [ 64 , 44 ] . Second, the interface must accommodate observed motion and control inputs : video-derived latents describe realized transitions, whereas command-derived latents specify controls whose effects depend on the scene. A forward command, for example, may produce no motion when an obstacle blocks the agent. The world model must therefore use visual context to predict the outcome of either input.
blocks.zh: 学习这一共享界面带来了两个挑战。 首先,规范化必须鼓励可重复使用的运动结构,而不放弃代表不同过渡所需的信息。 单是框架预测就可以在运动的同时保留特定场景或无控制的改变[64,44]. 第二,接口必须容纳观察到的动作和控制输入:视频衍生的潜想描述已实现的过渡,而指令衍生的潜想则指定其影响取决于现场的控制。 例如,当障碍阻碍代理人时,前方命令可能不会产生运动. 因此,世界模型必须利用视觉背景来预测两种投入的结果。

blocks.en: We introduce OneLA , a simple framework for learning a shared action interface from videos (Figure 1 ). A latent action model (LAM), formulated as an inverse dynamics model [ 24 ] , encodes frame pairs into continuous coefficients. We pretrain it across games, navigation, driving, and robotics without action labels, combining next-frame reconstruction with an orthonormal motion dictionary [ 56 ] , Kullback–Leibler (KL) regularization, and sparsity. We then freeze the LAM and train lightweight multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) on labeled trajectories to align native controls to its latent space. Finally, we train a shared diffusion transformer conditioned on the initial frame and either video-derived pseudo-actions or mapped native controls. It jointly predicts video and realized-transition latent actions, using frame-pair codes from the frozen LAM as action targets.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍OneLA, 一个简单的框架, 潜在动作模型(LAM),被制定为反向动态模型[24],将帧对编码为连续系数. 我们先在游戏、导航、驾驶和机器人中进行没有动作标签的训练, 将下帧重建与正态运动字典[56], Kullback - Leibler(KL)正规化, 和痉挛相结合。 然后我们冻结LAM,并在被标记的轨迹上训练轻量级多层受体(MLP),使原生控制与其潜入空间相配合. 最后,我们培训一个共享的传播变压器,其条件在初始框架上,或者是视频产生的伪动作,或者绘制出本地控制图。 它联合预测视频和实现过渡的潜在行动,利用被冻结的LAM的帧-页码作为行动目标.

blocks.en: We evaluate OneLA on six datasets spanning four domains. It improves linear-probe macro-F1 over the strongest listed baseline by 5.30 points on Game and 5.63 on AgiBot (Table 1 ). In world-model evaluation, it reduces action-cycle translation and rotation errors by 15.5% and 24.8% relative to OLaF and achieves the highest nuScenes peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity (SSIM) among the evaluated methods (Table 2 ).

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose a shared latent action interface learned from unlabeled videos through an orthonormal motion dictionary and coefficient regularization. • We introduce unified world-model training on labeled and unlabeled videos, combining native-control alignment with joint video and latent action prediction. • We evaluate OneLA across diverse domains, demonstrating improved action readout, cross-view transfer, and action-cycle consistency, with higher visual quality.

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1  Latent Actions from Video
blocks.zh: 2.1 来自视频的慢动作

blocks.en: Recent studies learn latent actions from visual transitions for controllable generation [ 6 , 23 ] and policy pretraining [ 60 , 8 , 16 , 51 ] . A central difficulty is that predictive codes can retain appearance and uncontrolled changes alongside motion [ 64 , 44 ] . Information bottlenecks restrict what the code can retain, trading off action abstraction against predictive detail. Discrete tokenizers [ 6 , 60 ] and regularized continuous spaces [ 23 , 24 ] make different choices in this trade-off, whose effects on action abstraction and prediction have motivated systematic study [ 62 , 9 ] . Beyond capacity, learning transferable actions requires deciding which visual changes should have similar representations. Methods guide this choice through agent masks, optical-flow targets, or action supervision [ 20 , 10 , 33 ] ; others impose content–structure separation [ 66 ] , compositional or cycle consistency [ 58 , 13 ] , or alignment to video-feature changes [ 35 ] . To structure continuous actions across sources, OneLA uses an orthonormal dictionary [ 56 ] that gives KL and sparsity regularization a consistent geometric scale. It learns through a common reconstruction objective without additional supervision or alignment targets during latent action pretraining. Table compares auxiliary objectives beyond transition prediction.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究从可控发电的视觉过渡[6、23]和政策预训[60、8、16、51]中学习潜在的行动。 一个核心的难题是预测代码可以保留外观和无控制的变化,与运动相伴[64,44]. 信息瓶颈限制了代码可以保留的东西,将动作抽象与预测细节进行交换. 分明的表示器[6,60]和正则化的连续空间[23,24]在这种取舍中作出不同的选择,其对动作抽象和预测的影响激发了系统的研究[62,9]. 除了能力之外,学习可转移的行动需要决定哪些视觉变化应有类似的表现。 方法通过代理口罩、光学流目标或动作监督[20、10、33]来指导这一选择;其他方法则规定内容-结构分离[66]、组成或周期一致性[58、13],或与视频特性变化相匹配[35]。 为了构建跨源的连续动作,OneLA使用正统字典[56],使KL和sparsity正规化具有相容的几何尺度. 它通过一个共同的重建目标学习,在潜在行动前培训期间没有额外的监督或调整目标。 表比较了过渡预测之外的辅助目标.

blocks.en: 2.2  World Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 世界模式

blocks.en: World models support control through video simulation [ 52 , 63 , 22 , 68 , 48 ] or feature-space prediction for planning [ 70 , 4 ] . Broad video pretraining supplies visual and dynamics priors [ 45 , 31 ] , while geometry and memory help maintain consistent rollouts [ 14 , 49 , 72 ] . Reusing these predictive models across domains also requires reconciling different control interfaces. Latent actions provide an intermediate representation: they connect unlabeled video pretraining to downstream commands [ 23 , 21 ] and make video-derived motion useful for imitation and feature-space dynamics [ 55 , 67 ] . Recent unified models further accommodate diverse controls through shared and modality-specific experts [ 19 ] or partially revealed visual trajectories [ 3 ] . OneLA couples a geometrically regularized action space with joint multi-domain video and action prediction, enabling native-command control and reference-action transfer through one shared world-model backbone.
blocks.zh: 世界模型通过视频模拟支持控制[52,63,22,68,48]或用于规划的地物-空间预测[70,4]. 宽广的视频预训提供视觉和动态前传[45,31],而几何和内存有助于保持连贯地展开[14,49,72]. 跨域再利用这些预测模型也需要调和不同的控制界面. Latett 动作提供了一种中间表现:它们将无标签的视频预训与下游指令[23,21]连接起来,并使得视频衍生出的运动对模仿和地物-空间动态[55,67]有用. 近期的统一模型通过共享和模式特定专家[19]或部分被揭示的视觉轨迹[3]进一步适应了不同的控制. OneLA将一个几何规范化的动作空间与多领域联合视频和行动预测,通过一个共享的世界模型主干线实现本地指令控制和参考动作转移。

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that OneLA achieves the best F1 on most datasets and the second-best on the rest under both full-representation linear probing and single-dimension readout. The latter uses one scalar latent dimension per action label. On Game, the single-dimension readout achieves 65.26 F1 versus 67.08 using all dimensions, indicating that action information is concentrated in individual coordinates. blocks.en: 5  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented OneLA , a shared latent action interface for world models across games, navigation, driving, and robotics. An orthonormal motion dictionary with variational and sparsity regularization structures motion representations learned from unlabeled videos. Lightweight command mappings connect native controls to this space, enabling unified video and action prediction from labeled and unlabeled data. Experiments show strong action readout, cross-view transfer, and action-cycle consistency, while the ablations support using latent actions to learn from unlabeled videos. Together, these results suggest that a common action representation can connect diverse control interfaces without requiring separate world-model backbones. Future work will extend this interface to longer-horizon planning and closed-loop interaction, and test whether it can adapt efficiently to new environments and embodiments.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了OneLA, 一个共享的潜在行动界面, 跨游戏、导航、驾驶和机器人的世界模型。 一个正态运动词典,有变异和斯帕森特态结构的正态运动表现从无标签的视频中吸取. 轻量级指令映射将本土控制与这个空间相连接,使得能够从被标签和无标签的数据中进行统一的视频和行动预测. 实验显示强烈的动作读取,交叉取景转移,以及动作周期的一致性,而模拟则支持利用潜伏动作从无标签视频中学习. 这些结果共同表明,共同行动代表可以将不同的控制界面连接起来,而不需要单独的世界模型骨干. 今后的工作将扩大这一接口,使之包括较长期的规划和闭路互动,并测试它是否能够有效地适应新的环境和新表现。

blocks.en: We compare the 32-dimensional OneLA with OLaF [ 35 ] , its VAE checkpoint without alignment, DiLA [ 66 ] , and the ManiSkill checkpoint of RLA-WM [ 67 ] . AdaWorld [ 23 ] uses its released 32-dimensional LAM and posterior-mean representations. All methods use the same evaluation pairs and dataset-specific readout protocol, retaining their native representation dimensions and input preprocessing. DiLA uses a 256-dimensional code; RLA-WM uses flattened residual features with 2,048 dimensions.

blocks.en: For OneLA , we use a consistent video-level train/test partition across LAM pretraining and world-model training. All test videos used in representation and world-model evaluations are excluded from both training stages. Our primary metric is macro-F1 from a single linear layer over the full representation. For MIND, we follow the train/test partition of Olaf-World [ 35 ] . Our MIND probe is an eight-way classifier; the other datasets use independent binary classifiers. We also test a restricted readout that selects one dimension per action by its absolute correlation with fit labels, then fits a sign and decision threshold. This single-dimension test measures how directly individual dimensions expose action information; it still requires labeled fit data. For nuScenes, we report full-representation probing. Within each dataset, all methods use the same probe-fitting protocol. AgiBot uses disjoint sets of 200 fit and 200 test episodes.
blocks.zh: 我们使用一致的视频级别列车/测试分区, 代表和世界示范评价中使用的所有测试录像都被排除在两个培训阶段之外。 我们的首要衡量尺度是宏-F1,从一个线性层到整个代表层。 对于MIND,我们遵循奥拉夫-World的列车/测试分区[35]. 我们的MIND探测器是一个八向分级器;其他数据集使用独立的二进制分级器. 我们还测试一个限制性的读出,通过它与适配标签的绝对相关性来选择每个动作的一个维度,然后符合一个标志和决定阈值. 这种单向分解测试测量单个维度如何直接暴露动作信息;它仍然需要贴有标签的相容数据. 对于nuScens,我们报告充分陈述的质询。 在每个数据集中,所有方法都使用相同的探测器匹配协议. AgiBot使用200个发配和200个测试集的脱节集.

blocks.en: All methods in Table 2 are evaluated after 6,000 fine-tuning updates. For OneLA , MIND, nuScenes, and RT-1 use a single shared checkpoint with the corresponding WASD/IJKL, pose, or RT-1 MLP. Inputs are the initial frame and keyboard commands on MIND, known ego-pose trajectories on nuScenes, or robot actions on RT-1; future target RGB frames are not used to extract action conditions. Cycle transfer extracts latent actions from the source video; the return pass extracts them from the generated transfer video and starts from the original source initial frame. The baselines are fine-tuned on the common 11-source mixture, including RT-1. Their LAMs remain frozen while the video model and action-conditioning components are jointly trained.
blocks.zh: 表2中的所有方法在6 000个微调更新后进行评估。 对于OneLA,MIND,nuScenes,和RT-1使用一个与相应的WASD/IJKL共用的单一检查站,姿势,或RT-1 MLP. 输入是MIND上的初始帧和键盘命令,已知自负-自负轨道在nuScenes上,或机器人动作在RT-1上;未来的目标RGB帧不用于提取动作条件. 循环传输从源视频中提取出潜在动作;返回通道从生成的传输视频中提取出并从原始源初始帧开始. 基线在包括RT-1在内的11源共同混合物上进行了微调. 他们的LAMS仍然被冻结,而视频模型和动作调节组件则接受联合培训.

blocks.en: For OneLA , test videos are held out from both LAM pretraining and world-model training, following the shared partition in Appendix B . All four methods use the same fixed test cases, 50 denoising steps, guidance scale 3, and seed 42. MIND contains 100 videos of 97 frames at 24 FPS. nuScenes and RT-1 each contain 40 videos. Cycle transfer contains 40 videos, evenly divided among the four source–target–source domain combinations. Metrics are first averaged within each video and then equally across videos. Scores cover all test cases. Relative improvements are computed from unrounded scores.
blocks.zh: 对OneLA来说,测试录像来自LAM预训和世界模式训练,这是在附录B的共享分区之后进行的。 所有四种方法都使用相同的固定试验箱,50个去诺步骤,3号制导尺度和42号种子. MIND在24个FPS中包含由97帧组成的100个视频. nuScens和RT-1各包含40个视频. 循环传输包含40个视频,在四个源-目标-源域组合中均分. 量度首先在每个视频中平均,然后在视频中平均。 分数覆盖所有测试案例. 相对改进是根据未四舍五入的分数计算的。

blocks.en: PSNR (dB), SSIM [ 57 ] , and LPIPS [ 65 ] with the VGG16 backbone compare predictions and ground truth at the original video geometry, excluding the conditioning frame. IQ is MUSIQ-SPAQ [ 36 ] rescaled to [ 0,100 ] [0,100] for reporting, evaluated on all frames including the first frame with the existing VBench [ 32 ] long-side-512 preprocessing. IQ measures visual quality rather than action correctness.
blocks.zh: PSNR (dB),SSIM [57],和LPIPS [65] 与VGG16主干比较了原始视频几何上的预测和地上真相,不包括取材框. IQ是MUSIQ-SPAQ [36] 调整为[0,100][0,100],用于报告,在所有框架上进行评估,包括第一个框架与现有的V Bench [32]长边-512预处理. IQ测量视觉质量而不是动作正确.

blocks.en: MIND and cycle RPE use ViPE [ 30 ] default pose estimation, Sim(3) alignment of the predicted trajectory to the reference, and adjacent-frame relative poses ( Δ = 1 \Delta=1 ). Translation error is expressed in the estimated reference-trajectory scale; rotation error is in degrees. MIND uses 24 FPS. Cycle evaluation uses 16 FPS and the source video’s actual length (21, 41, or 121 frames), comparing the returned video to the source. RPE is aggregated separately within each benchmark.
blocks.zh: MIND和循环REPE使用VIPE [30] 默认表示估计,Sim(3)将预测的轨迹与参考物相匹配,相邻的帧相对外观(XQ= 1\Delta= 1). 翻译错误用估计的参考-弹射尺度表示;旋转错误用度表示. IND使用24个FPS. 循环评价使用16个FPS和源视频的实际长度(21个,41个,或121个帧),将返回的视频与源进行对比. REPE在每个基准内分别汇总.

blocks.en: Figure 5 (a–c) compares training w/ and w/o latent action after 6,000 fine-tuning updates. Both settings use the same data and training procedure, train the MLPs, and retain the initial frame and native-command pathway. The only difference is whether unlabeled videos receive LAM-inferred latent actions or zero action vectors. The real-scene test uses game-action commands with 30 initial frames, ten each from Sekai, Spatial-Vid, and RealEstate10K. For HPSv3 [ 42 ] , we uniformly sample 16 frames per generated video, excluding the initial frame and rounding indices to the nearest frame. Each case uses the same fixed target-scene text caption across setups and frames. We average raw preference means ( μ \mu ) across frames and then equally across videos. This measures visual preference rather than control correctness. The collision comparison in panel (d) is a separate 50-case test of each loss setting. Collision outcomes are verified by human inspection of the generated videos. Collision rates are 36% (18/50) without the latent-action prediction loss and 22% (11/50) with it.
blocks.zh: 图5(a-c)比较了培训w/和w/潜在行动在6 000个微调更新后的情况。 两种设置都使用相同的数据和培训程序,培训MLP,并保留初始帧和本地指令路径. 唯一的区别是无标签的视频是接收LAM-受孕后的潜在动作还是零动作向量. 真景测试采用游戏动作指令,有30个初始帧,分别来自Sekai,Space-Vid,和RealEstate10K. 对于HPSv3 [42],我们统一抽取了每个生成的视频的16帧,不包括初始帧和四舍五入到最近帧的指数. 每个案例在设置和框架之间使用相同的固定目标-场景文本标题。 我们平均的原始偏好是指(μ\mu)跨相框, 这衡量视觉偏好而不是控制正确性。 (d)面板中的相撞比较是对每一损失设定的单独50个案例的测试。 碰撞结果由人类对生成的视频进行检查加以核实。 碰撞率为36%(18/50),没有潜在动作预测损失,同为22%(11/50)。
